instruction: Candid documentary photograph, low-angle medium-wide shot. Inside a gym with training equipment and mirrors, the bearded man in the colorful patterned sleeves (R3) on the left sits on the floor, stretching his right leg out wide while looking to the right with a slight smile. Beside him, the man in the black graphic t-shirt (R1) on the right crouches low in a deep squat stretch, head bowed down, wearing blue athletic shoes. The two men stretch side-by-side on the floor. Soft, natural indoor lighting with warm tones casts gentle shadows across the training area.
